datasets.frequency: Hourly offered in the request form; subhourly availability unverified.
datasets.coverage: Request Male island gauges and the nearest available Hulhule station; require station metadata.
datasets.cost_licence: Complementary to Maldivian nationals and qualifying research; application purpose only; no third-party redistribution without written MMS permission
datasets.verification: Official form indexed; no data requested or obtained; current website may redirect.
datasets.recommendation: Primary source for short-duration local rainfall

datasets.dataset: NOAA ISD Global Hourly / Velana Intl
datasets.frequency: Hourly/synoptic meteorological reports; precipitation groups in the tested years are 6-, 12- and 24-hour totals, not hourly rainfall.
datasets.coverage: 2024 calendar year and 2025 Jan 1-Aug 24 downloaded. Station-history metadata spans 1981 Jan 1-2025 Aug 24 with possible gaps.
datasets.cost_licence: Free download without login; cite NOAA and station source.
datasets.verification: 2024: 10,784 meteorological rows; 1,666 nonempty AA groups, including 30 missing depths. 2025: 7,198 rows; 1,128 AA groups, including 21 missing depths. No 1-hour AA precipitation group found in either year. Quality and condition flags retained.
datasets.recommendation: Measured nearby-station context at 6-hour/daily scale. Obtain MMS data for hourly/subhourly rainfall bursts.

datasets.coverage: 2024: 355 dates, 354 nonmissing PRCP. 2025: 236 dates through Aug 24, all 236 with PRCP. Hulhule airport is not Male island proper.
datasets.verification: PRCP units are inches; raw attributes retained. 2024 is not complete. Missing dates and sentinel values are not zero.
datasets.recommendation: Screen event dates and broad daily context; unsuitable for peak short-duration intensity or within-city rainfall variation.

datasets.access: Free registration / Earthdata or PPS download route; files not downloaded
datasets.coverage: Official directory: Jan 1998-present, with about 3.5 months latency for Final. Global ocean/land coverage includes Male latitude; actual Male values have not been extracted here.
datasets.format: HDF5, NetCDF and GeoTIFF/subsets, depending on access route.
datasets.cost_licence: Free NASA data; Earthdata or PPS registration for common download routes.
datasets.verification: Official directory and product documentation checked.
datasets.recommendation: Best gridded subdaily fallback for regional event timing. Validate against gauges; not street-scale precipitation. Convert rate (mm/hour) to half-hour depth by multiplying by 0.5.

datasets.coverage: 1940-present global atmosphere. A nearby grid point is returned for an off-grid request. Male island is not resolved.
datasets.cost_licence: CC-BY; free CDS registration and licence acceptance required.
datasets.verification: Official dataset and download form checked; data not downloaded.
datasets.recommendation: Secondary reanalysis baseline; a large marine grid cell does not measure local convective rainfall peaks.

datasets.frequency: Hourly; 0.1 degree delivery grid, about 9 km native.
datasets.coverage: 1950-present land component. Valid Male grid-cell coverage has not been verified.
datasets.format: GRIB and other CDS service formats.
datasets.verification: Official catalogue checked; no actual Male valid-pixel test.
datasets.recommendation: Do not treat global extent as proof of valid values on a tiny island. ERA5 atmosphere avoids this land-mask issue but remains coarse.

datasets.frequency: Daily values derived from pentads; 0.05 degree grid (about 5.6 km), not subdaily.
datasets.coverage: Land, 60 N-60 S. At 4.175 N, 73.510 E the 2025 Jan 3 final-sat COG contains a valid estimate of 108.274635314941 mm. One pixel/date is verified, not the complete historical record.
datasets.verification: Official v3 description and daily README checked. Actual COG sampled using GDAL; a 3-by-3-cell context GeoTIFF is saved. CHIRPS v2 ends after Dec 2026.
datasets.recommendation: Useful for daily/climate context, not short-duration waterlogging intensity. Daily v3 inherits pentad totals and ERA5/IMERG timing; do not use agreement with those inputs as independent validation.

local_files_status: QA and examples only. NOAA Global Hourly CSV files are meteorological reports, not 1-hour rainfall. Derived AA rows retain flags and need further QC. The NASA POWER sample is MERRA2 reanalysis.
